from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data from one company's financial report for the special reserve item."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    company_stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock/security code if available")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    special_reserve_ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="Special reserve ending balance if reported in this document")
    special_reserve_beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="Special reserve beginning balance if reported in this document")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the special reserve data, if available")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
